profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, listed under the ticker XPEV. Its Spanish site presents the brand as offering a fully electric range under the slogan "Xpande tu mundo," and states that the company has been turning what the world calls the future into reality since 2014. The site describes three models, the G6, G9 and P7+, as combining artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems and the SEPA 2.0 800-volt electric platform, which it says allows charging from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. All three models carry the DGT CERO label and a warranty of up to 7 years or 160,000 km, according to the site.

The site also sets out financing offers for two of the models. For the XPENG G6 RWD Standard Range 185kW it lists a cash price of 43.010,31€ and a financed price of 39.410,31€, with a deposit of 12.870,68€, a 36-month term, a debtor rate of 2,99% and a T.A.E. of 3,04%. For the XPENG G9 RWD Standard Range it lists a cash price of 59.010,30€ and a financed price of 59.010,29€, with a deposit of 22.870,53€, a debtor rate of 5,99% and a T.A.E. of 6,17%. The site names CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. as the data controller for enquiries submitted through the page, and states that the financing is offered subject to review and approval by Open Bank, S.A.

The company's record shows no tracked products, no lawsuits and no MCP servers.
